# ARIADNE — Mechanistic Partner Discovery
====================================
**Seed disease:** congenital hereditary endothelial dystrophy of cornea (MONDO:0009019)
**Generated:** 2026-07-31
**Candidates screened:** 2 gene-neighbour(s), 0 pathway-neighbour(s)

*ARIADNE proposes candidate mechanistic links for expert validation. It does not diagnose or recommend clinical action. Tiers reflect computational fitness against the Monarch Knowledge Graph, not established clinical validity.*

### RANKED PARTNERS
| # | Disease | Link | Tier | Fitness | Shared gene / pathway |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | corneal dystrophy-perceptive deafness syndrome (MONDO:0009015) | shared gene | Tier 1 | 0.740 | HGNC:16438 |
| 2 | corneal dystrophy, Fuchs endothelial, 4 (MONDO:0013204) | shared gene | Tier 1 | 0.726 | HGNC:16438 |

### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. corneal dystrophy-perceptive deafness syndrome  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.740)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:16438)

**Proposed mechanism:** Pathogenic variant in SLC4A11 (PMID:16877379) —DISRUPTS→ SLC4A11 (HGNC:10839); SLC4A11 (HGNC:10839) —DISRUPTS→ Endothelial cell bicarbonate homeostasis and pH regulation (GO:0035948); Endothelial cell bicarbonate homeostasis and pH regulation (GO:0035948) —LEADS_TO→ Corneal endothelial dysfunction (HP:0000578); Endothelial cell bicarbonate homeostasis and pH regulation (GO:0035948) —LEADS_TO→ Perceptive deafness (HP:0000405). Pathogenic variants in SLC4A11 disrupt its function as a bicarbonate/proton exchanger, leading to impaired endothelial cell homeostasis. This dysfunction underlies corneal endothelial dystrophy in CHED and, in corneal dystrophy-perceptive deafness syndrome, contributes to both corneal endothelial dysfunction and perceptive deafness.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of a pathogenic variant in SLC4A11 with a significant allele frequency (>1%) in gnomAD, or the discovery of distinct causal genes for the two conditions. _(variant: rs112777678)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of SLC4A11 in both conditions could lead to therapeutic strategies targeting endothelial cell function or bicarbonate transport that might benefit patients with either disease, particularly for the corneal manifestations.

---

#### 2. corneal dystrophy, Fuchs endothelial, 4  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.726)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:16438)

**Proposed mechanism:** SLC4A11 (HGNC:10525) —DISRUPTS→ Corneal endothelial cell homeostasis and ion transport (REACT:R-HSA-74702); Corneal endothelial cell homeostasis and ion transport (REACT:R-HSA-74702) —LEADS_TO→ Corneal edema (HP:0000518); Corneal endothelial cell homeostasis and ion transport (REACT:R-HSA-74702) —LEADS_TO→ Corneal opacity (HP:0000507). Loss-of-function variants in SLC4A11 disrupt corneal endothelial cell homeostasis and ion transport, leading to corneal edema and opacity in both diseases.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of pathogenic variants in SLC4A11 that consistently lead to gain-of-function or dominant-negative effects, or the absence of any significant overlap in corneal edema and opacity phenotypes between individuals with SLC4A11 variants. _(variant: rs141191383)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of SLC4A11 in both CHED and FECD4 can inform the development of targeted therapies aimed at restoring ion transport and endothelial cell function in the cornea, potentially benefiting patients with both conditions.
